cards.title: Navigating Grandparent Gift Choices
cards.body: A parent struggles with a mother-in-law who buys overly feminine clothing for their daughter. The piece explores the tension between accepting generosity and enforcing your own parenting values.

cards.title: Parenting Adult Children With Schizophrenia
cards.body: A daughter shares her father's strategies for supporting an adult child living with a psychotic disorder. The article provides practical parenting advice for navigating mental health challenges.

cards.title: Understanding College Homesickness in Young Adults
cards.body: Homesickness during the first year of college is common but can feel like a crisis. The guide offers six practical steps to help students move through this difficult transition.

cards.title: Bearing Children in Uncertain Times
cards.body: A parent reflects on the timeless question of choosing to have children in a fractured world. The piece explores what keeps families hopeful when facing global uncertainty.

cards.title: IKEA Shopping and Parenting Wisdom
cards.body: A parent discovers their parenting failures through a pre-university shopping trip to IKEA. The humorous piece reflects on what domestic lessons actually stick with children.

cards.title: The Last Ordinary Moments With Children
cards.body: Many ordinary moments with your child that feel like they'll happen again are often the last. Learning to notice and appreciate these fleeting times transforms parenting awareness.

cards.title: Emotional Regulation and Child Development
cards.body: Children need education in understanding and managing emotions to regulate their nervous systems. Without emotional literacy tools, kids struggle to develop healthy emotional health.

cards.title: When Defiance Means Something Different
cards.body: A former student challenged a teacher's understanding of ODD (Oppositional Defiant Disorder) and changed how they evaluate difficult behavior. The experience shows the importance of looking deeper into what defiance actually means.

cards.title: Suburban Living and Family Adaptation
cards.body: A family's move to the suburbs initially felt boring until they learned where to find community and connection. The experience shows how perspective shifts when you know where to look for excitement.
